get.summary: Retrieve available exam schedule slots by filters
get.description:
Retrieves a paginated list of available exam schedule slots. There are two filtering modes:

1. **By exact instant** — provide only startDate (ISO-8601 timestamp). scheduleId becomes required and the endpoint returns slots whose start time equals exactly that instant.

2. **By date range** — provide startDate and endDate (both ISO-8601). Returns slots whose start time falls within the range. Providing endDate without startDate is invalid.

Returns an empty page (HTTP 200) when no slots match the filter.
